journeys.title: Cancelling a subscription

moments.say: Alice cancels; the provider accepts and she gets an email.
She presses cancel again, and nothing changes.
She asks for a refund of the unused part of the period and is turned down.
The paid period ends and her access ends with it.

journeys.goal: Alice no longer wants to pay, but has paid for the current period.

journeys.title: The provider does not cooperate

moments.say: Bob cancels, but the provider does not answer in time.
A second try gets no answer either.
A third try is declined by the provider. Bob is still subscribed and still billed.
The next try goes through, and Bob is told in the app.

journeys.goal: Bob wants to cancel while the billing provider is having a bad day.

examples.text: Cancel mid-period: billing stops, access stays
Provider declines: the subscription stays Active
After three unanswered tries there is no fourth
A refund request after cancelling is refused
The paid period ends: access stops
A decline after an unanswered try resets the retry count
A successful cancel after an unanswered try resets the retry count
Cancel journey: retry succeeds, repeat is harmless, period ends, refund refused
Declined journey: the provider declines, the retry goes through
